parent_objective: run one public seed across all 12 corrected controller-family profiles
blocked_by: pilot result must be audited before interpretation or scaling
supersedes: direct three-seed matrix before one-seed plumbing
direct private holdout before public plumbing
direct decisive clean-package benchmark before mapping

public_gates: M1674 must run all 12 corrected profile configs with seed offset 0
M1674 must use equal committed profile budgets and no profile-specific tuning
M1674 must write summary protocol profile_seed_rows profile_aggregate and eval_rows artifacts
M1674 must keep private holdout promotion actor-input changes paper-level claims and level3 claims blocked
M1674 must route to audit before interpretation
forbidden_shortcuts: do not repair the M1663 artifact
do not execute decisive clean-package benchmark
do not tune one profile separately

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs the first one-seed public standard-layer plumbing pilot for all 12 controller profiles
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public plumbing benchmark only; no promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if any profile is omitted
stop if profile-specific tuning is used
stop if private holdout or promotion is attempted
stop if one-seed results are interpreted without audit
fallback_plan: route to runner repair if any profile fails
route to metric audit if non-finite values appear
route to result audit if all public plumbing gates pass
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1673 admits one implementation of the one-seed public pilot

admission_evidence: M1673 pre-registers the command and metrics
M1671 protocol preflight verified the profile configs
allowed_training: PPO training inside autodrift.corrected_profile_pilot for seed offset 0 only
allowed_updates: M1674 status queue scoreboard research log and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1674 includes L1 and L2 current-tiled controls but one seed is diagnostic only.
history_necessity_tests: run L2 normal and current-tiled controls under the same one-seed protocol
run L3 online and corrected reset controls under the same one-seed protocol
do not claim history necessity from one seed
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: one public seed under standard corrected profile layer only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Any negative or surprising result must be audited before changing the protocol.
allowed_claims: no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: All 12 corrected controller-family profiles can complete one public train/eval seed with finite metrics under the same committed budget.
failure_criteria: one-seed result is claimed as controller-family ranking

commands.name: one_seed_public_pilot
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.corrected_profile_pilot --config-dir configs/paper_route_corrected_profiles --config-glob 'm1207_*.json' --run-dir runs/m1674_controller_family_one_seed_public_pilot --training-seed-base 167400 --seed-offsets 0 --eval-seed-base 167500 --eval-episodes 64 --device cpu

decision_rule: M1674 passes if all 12 profiles complete the one-seed public pilot with finite metrics and blocked shortcuts remain false.
